text:
### Missing KYC Documentation  
```
Exception: Account opened without identity verification (audit finding)
Investigation: KYC file missing; customer opened via online
Resolution: Email customer, request identity document immediately
SLA: 5 days (account restricted if doc not provided)
```  
---
name: Chunk 22/25

raw_entities.name: Missing KYC Documentation Exception Handling
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for resolving accounts opened without complete identity verification. Triggered by audit findings of missing KYC documentation in online-opened accounts. Includes customer notification, document collection, and account restriction enforcement within a 5-day SLA.
context: Account opened without identity verification (audit finding)
KYC file missing; customer opened via online
Email customer, request identity document immediately
SLA: 5 days (account restricted if doc not provided)

raw_entities.name: KYC File Audit Review
raw_entities.description: Audit control step that identifies accounts opened without complete identity verification documentation. Detects missing KYC files as an exception condition requiring immediate remediation.
context: Account opened without identity verification (audit finding)
KYC file missing; customer opened via online

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Document Request
raw_entities.description: Communication step where the customer is contacted via email to provide missing identity documentation. Initiates the remediation timeline and establishes the 5-day compliance deadline.
context: Email customer, request identity document immediately

raw_entities.name: Account Restriction Enforcement
raw_entities.description: Enforcement step applied if the customer fails to provide required identity documentation within the 5-day SLA. Account functionality is restricted pending document receipt and verification.
context: SLA: 5 days (account restricted if doc not provided)

raw_entities.name: Audit Function
raw_entities.description: Internal audit team responsible for identifying and flagging accounts opened without complete KYC documentation as an exception condition.
context: Account opened without identity verification (audit finding)

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Operations
raw_entities.description: Operations team responsible for sending email notifications to customers requesting missing identity documentation and managing the remediation workflow.
context: Email customer, request identity document immediately

raw_entities.name: Document Receipt Decision
raw_entities.description: Binary decision point at the 5-day SLA boundary: if identity document is provided, proceed to verification; if not provided, apply account restriction. Determines whether the account can remain active or must be restricted.
context: SLA: 5 days (account restricted if doc not provided)

raw_entities.name: Identity Verification Compliance Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory regulatory control point verifying that all accounts have complete identity verification documentation on file before account activation. Failure to meet this checkpoint triggers exception handling and account restriction.
context: Account opened without identity verification (audit finding)
KYC file missing; customer opened via online

raw_entities.name: Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: Know Your Customer identity verification process required for all account openings. In this exception case, verification was not completed during online account opening and must be remediated through document collection.
context: Account opened without identity verification (audit finding)
KYC file missing; customer opened via online

raw_entities.name: Identity Document
raw_entities.description: Official identity document required to complete KYC verification for the account. Customer must provide this document within 5 days to avoid account restriction.
context: Email customer, request identity document immediately
SLA: 5 days (account restricted if doc not provided)

raw_entities.name: Online-Opened Account
raw_entities.description: Customer account opened through online channel without complete identity verification documentation. Subject to exception handling and potential restriction if KYC documentation is not provided within 5 days.
context: Account opened without identity verification (audit finding)
KYC file missing; customer opened via online
SLA: 5 days (account restricted if doc not provided)

raw_entities.description: Individual customer who opened an account via online channel without providing required identity verification documentation. Subject to remediation request and potential account restriction.
context: KYC file missing; customer opened via online
